label: Gym / Fitness Studio
description: Gyms, fitness studios, CrossFit boxes, yoga and dance studios, personal-training centres.

headlineKpi.label: New reviews per week
headlineKpi.help: Gym enquiries convert on recent social proof. Reviews from the last 90 days matter far more than the lifetime total.

issueTaxonomy.label: Broken or insufficient equipment
issueTaxonomy.action: Publish a repair log at the entrance: what is out of service, and the date it returns. Fix the machine named most often first.

issueTaxonomy.label: Overcrowding at peak hours
issueTaxonomy.action: Publish live peak-hour occupancy at the desk and cap peak-slot sign-ups for the busiest hour.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: how packed it gets at peak times

issueTaxonomy.label: Trainer absent or inattentive
issueTaxonomy.action: Roster a named floor trainer for every hour the gym is open and put the roster on the wall.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: not getting the guidance you needed

issueTaxonomy.label: Cleanliness / changing rooms
issueTaxonomy.action: Add an hourly cleaning sign-off for the floor, washroom and changing room, visible to members.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the state of the changing rooms

issueTaxonomy.label: Membership / refund disputes
issueTaxonomy.action: Give every member a written copy of the freeze, transfer and refund terms at signup, and stop verbal-only promises.

issueTaxonomy.label: AC / ventilation / temperature
issueTaxonomy.action: Service the AC and add exhaust in the busiest zone; log temperature at peak hour for a week.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: how stuffy it gets on the floor

issueTaxonomy.label: Front-desk / staff behaviour
issueTaxonomy.action: Brief the desk on how to handle a freeze, cancellation and complaint without escalating.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the way you were dealt with at the desk

issueTaxonomy.label: Sales promises not kept
issueTaxonomy.action: Remove every claim from the sales pitch that is not written in the membership form.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: being told one thing and finding another
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: joining ke waqt kahi gayi baat alag nikalne

issueTaxonomy.label: Classes cancelled or changed
issueTaxonomy.action: Fix the class timetable for a month and notify members in advance of any change.

issueTaxonomy.label: Parking / access
issueTaxonomy.action: Publish parking guidance on the listing and at the entrance.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: how hard it is to park

praiseTaxonomy.label: Trainer knowledge and attention
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: your trainer knows what they are doing
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: trainer ko apna kaam aata hai

praiseTaxonomy.label: Good equipment
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the equipment is up to scratch

praiseTaxonomy.label: Motivating atmosphere
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the floor has a good atmosphere

praiseTaxonomy.label: Convenient timings
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: timings aapke liye theek baithti hain

exampleReplies: Thanks for flagging the machine. It should not have stayed out of service that long. Please speak to the floor manager so we can tell you exactly when it is back.
Great to hear the trainers are helping. Passing this to the floor team.

staffAskScript.when: After a member completes a milestone session or renews, at the front desk.
staffAskScript.line: If the gym has been working for you, an honest review really helps other people decide. The QR at the desk takes a minute.
staffAskScript.hinglishLine: Agar gym aapke liye theek chal raha hai, toh ek honest review dusron ko decide karne mein help karta hai. Desk par QR hai, ek minute.
staffAskScript.marathiLine: जिम तुमच्यासाठी उपयुक्त ठरत असेल, तर प्रामाणिक अभिप्राय इतरांना निर्णय घ्यायला मदत करतो. डेस्कवरचा QR एक मिनिट घेतो.
doNot: Never offer free days, discounts or protein samples for a review.
Never ask only members who look satisfied.
Never write a review on a member's phone.
Never ask a member to delete or edit a review.

profileGapChecks.label: No recent photos of the floor and equipment

contentTemplates.label: Reply — broken equipment
contentTemplates.body:
Thanks for flagging this. Equipment being out of service for that long is on us. Please speak to the floor manager — we will tell you exactly when it is back.

— Team {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Reply — positive review
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you — the floor team will be glad to read this. See you at the next session.

— Team {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Front-desk card headline
contentTemplates.body: Is the gym working for you?

contentTemplates.label: Front-desk card subhead
contentTemplates.body: Scan and tell us honestly — it takes a minute.
